mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE user_id = #{parentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY account_id LIMIT 1

SELECT u.user_id AS id, u.name AS name, u.status AS status, w.wallet_id AS walletId FROM family_relations fr JOIN users u ON u.user_id = fr.child_id LEFT JOIN wallets w ON w.child_id = u.user_id WHERE fr.parent_id = #{parentId} AND fr.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.user_id
SELECT parent_id FROM family_relations WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY relation_id LIMIT 1
SELECT status AS status, relation_id AS requestId FROM family_relations WHERE child_id = #{childId} ORDER BY relation_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, password, name, phone, birth, user_type, role, status, invite_code ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{birth}, #{userType}, #{role}, #{status}, #{inviteCode} )
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} AND role = 'USER' AND user_type = 'PARENT' AND status = 'ACTIVE' )
